name: battle-command-labels-remaining
reviewNotes: Reviewed all original glyph sheets. This finished selection contains 62 command/weather/stat labels, curse phrases, quiz choices and equipment labels needing a Chinese change. Preserve the 10 previously released entries and 23 unchanged blank/separator, numeric or identical Han-character entries.

Compact command/weather/stat labels below index 35 are at most three cells. Longer curse phrases and quiz answers use the standard 14-cell static check; native menu layout and callers remain unverified. Weather names match the common-battle draft.

Quiz choices were checked against battle-events-remaining questions 86-101. Preserve all numeric alternatives, including wrong answers; translate tree/animal counters as trees/turtles rather than generic books or horses. Preserve hours, speed, currency, dates, passenger counts and paired numbers.
